name: tripod-dumbbell-row
instructions:
1. Assume a kneeling position on the bench with your ipsilateral (i.e. same side) hand braced against the bench.
2. Hold a dumbbell in the opposite hand with a neutral grip.
3. Begin the movement by driving the elbow behind the body while retracting the shoulder blade.
4. Pull the dumbbell towards your body until the elbow is at (or just past) the midline and then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position under control.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
